'''S4-E Support Droid''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Rishi]] in [[3637 BBY]] it assisted the Revanites [[Rarrook]] and [[Marko Ka]] who tried to stop a strike team from reaching the signal jammer on the [[Razorback Island]], but failed and were killed along with the droid.

==Behind the scenes==
S4-E Support Droid appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
